description: Defines overlay widget classes and enums for ANGLE project, including widget types, IDs, and specific widget classes like Count, PerSecond, Text, RunningGraph, and RunningHistogram.

classes.name: Widget
classes.description: Base class for overlay widgets, containing common properties and virtual destructor.

classes.name: Count
classes.description: Widget class representing a count of events, with methods to add and reset count.

classes.name: PerSecond
classes.description: Derived from Count, representing a per-second event count.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Widget class for displaying text, with method to set text content.

classes.name: RunningGraph
classes.description: Widget class for displaying a graph of last N values, with methods to add values and move to next.

classes.name: RunningHistogram
classes.description: Derived from RunningGraph, representing histogram of values between 0 and 1.

classes.name: Dummy
classes.description: Placeholder class used when overlay is disabled, with noop methods.

methods.name: RunningGraph(size_t n)
methods.description: Constructor for RunningGraph, initializes with size n.

methods.name: set(float n)
methods.description: Sets the histogram rank based on a float value between 0 and 1.

methods.name: add(size_t n)
methods.description: Adds a value to the widget's data.

methods.name: next()
methods.description: Advances to the next position in the widget's data buffer.

methods.name: set(std::string &&str)
methods.description: Sets the text content of the Text widget.
